name: Quivver → BTB — v3 (Looped Runway, vocal-safe)
description: Fix for v2: BTB's 'da da da' vocal enters at original bar 16. In v2, 3 loop copies only pushed this to extended bar 32, where Quivver was still at ~40%. v3 uses 4 loop copies = 32 bars of clean kick, so the vocal doesn't appear until extended bar 40 — exactly where the overlap ends and Quivver is at 0.0.

tracks.name: Quivver — Brothers & Sisters (Original Mix)
tracks.notes: LUFS -14.2. cue_out at 226 (melody end). Loop last 8 bars (218-226) x4 = 32 bars of kick/bass runway.

tracks.name: Below The Belt (Chris Micali Remix)
tracks.notes: LUFS -13.9. v3: Loop first 8 bars x4 = 32 bars of pure kick in 1A. Vocal 'da da da' enters at original bar 16 = extended bar 40 (overlap end). Bars 8-15 are also pure kick (verified by spectral analysis).

transitions.notes: v3: Same 40-bar overlap and automation as v2. The fix is in the loop count — 4 copies instead of 3 ensures the entire overlap is pure kick. Extended bar timeline: 0-31 = looped kick, 32-39 = original bars 8-15 (still pure kick per spectral analysis), bar 40 = original bar 16 (vocal enters, but overlap is over).
